For LPC Associates and licensed therapists, online across Texas

Supervision, consultation and training

Reem Glasco, LPC-S, has been a Texas LPC supervisor since 2009. There are three ways to work with her professionally: LPC supervision at $425 a month for four individual hours and one group hour, EMDR consultation at $185 an hour with an EMDRIA Approved Consultant, and retreats and equine training for clinicians who want to develop their own presence. All of it runs online except the retreats and the horses.

Is this you?

Who tends to work well here

The associate who wants more than hours

You could get cheaper supervision. What you want is someone who will tell you what actually happened in that session, and help you build something after licensure.

The therapist whose EMDR keeps stalling

Preparation looks fine, then processing floods or flatlines. Usually that is a part of the client objecting, and it is workable once you can see it.

The clinician running on empty

Competent, respected, quietly depleted. You teach regulation skills you no longer practice. That is what the retreats are for.

The one drawn to body-based work

You have read about somatic approaches and want to practice inside one. NARM, Somatic Experiencing and IFS-informed EMDR are the working lens here, not electives.

Why Reem

Supervision and therapy from someone who is still doing the work.

Licensed in Texas since before most of her supervisees started graduate school, and still in the room every week. What follows is why people choose this practice over a cheaper hour or a closer office.

Sixteen years as a Texas supervisor

LPC-S since 2009, license 66562, with over fifteen years of clinical practice behind it. Long enough to have seen most of what walks in, and to know the difference between a hard case and a stuck therapist.

A body-based lens, not a borrowed one

NARM therapist, Somatic Experiencing Practitioner, EMDR certified and an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Trainings completed, not modalities mentioned.

Small by design

Two supervision openings a year and a limited therapy caseload. Nobody here is one of thirty. That is the trade: less availability, more attention.

Honest feedback, offered kindly

If nothing you bring is ever questioned, you are paying for a signature. Expect to be asked what you were doing and why, and to be told when something in the work is yours rather than the client's.

Questions therapists ask first

Are you accepting new LPC Associates?

One supervision spot opens in fall 2026 and one in spring 2027. Supervision is capped deliberately, so it is worth booking a consult before a spot opens rather than after.

Can I do EMDR consultation without being supervised by you?

Yes. Consultation is separate from supervision and open to any licensed therapist trained in EMDR, at $185 an hour online. LPC Associates under Reem's supervision get individual EMDR consults at no additional cost.

Do I have to be in Texas?

For LPC supervision, yes: the supervised experience requirement is set by the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council and applies to Texas LPC Associates. EMDR consultation is a peer professional relationship rather than clinical care, so it is not limited to Texas, though you should check what your own board expects.

What is the first step?

A free thirty-minute consult by Zoom or phone. For supervision, applications then need a CV, three professional references, and answers to the seven questions listed on the supervision page.

Ready when you are

Start with a conversation

Therapy consults are fifteen minutes. Supervision and EMDR consultation consults are thirty. Both are free and commit you to nothing.
